Your plan has a contradiction: criteria 0 and 1 clash

Fix only this contradiction and keep every other part of your previous plan unchanged. Reply with the full corrected plan.

## Report format

End your final message with:

```sushi-plan
{"title":"...","goal":"...","tier":"mechanical|standard|hard","criteria":[],"coverage":[{"requirement":"...","criteria":[0]}],"verify":[],"checks":[{"criterion":0,"run":"..."}],"heldOut":{"criterion":0,"run":"..."},"tests":[{"path":"...","content":"..."}],"screenshot":"","finalVerify":[],"paths":["src/..."],"questions":[{"text":"...","options":["...","..."],"risk":[],"defaultOption":null,"recommended":"...","evidence":"...","blocking":false}]}
```

`risk` names what a question commits the owner to, from scope (a change against the request), money, destructive, security, public-api (a public API or contract change), push or deploy (empty when none).
